prompt: 오늘 할 일 브리핑해줘. 지난 항목, 오늘 마감, 이번 주 예정, 기한 없는 항목을 나눠서 보여줘.
expected_behavior: Reads bounded current Reminders state first, normalizes today's date and timezone, groups results by operational status, and includes exact list or section names without dumping raw rows.

prompt: 스크린샷 파일을 '취업캠프 준비' 미리알림에 첨부하고 아이폰에서 보일 수 있는지 확인해줘.
expected_behavior: If Experimental tools are absent, explains the limit and offers an appropriate Core or manual Reminders action without enabling them. Only in an explicitly enabled Experimental session: Resolves the exact reminder and source image, obtains a fresh opaque reference, inspects attachments, uses change_reminder_attachment with attach_image and an idempotency key, and reports mobile evidence without claiming iPhone confirmation.

prompt: '생각 주머니' 목록에서 실행 가능한 항목만 이번 주 섹션으로 옮겨줘.
expected_behavior: If Experimental tools are absent, explains the limit and offers an appropriate Core or manual Reminders action without enabling them. Only in an explicitly enabled Experimental session: Inspects the exact list and section structure, identifies the qualifying set, obtains a fresh opaque reference for each target, uses organize_reminder move_to_section, and avoids broad moves unless standing delegation or approval covers them.

Searches bounded candidates, disambiguates duplicates, reads the exact Reminder for a fresh opaque reference, calls delete_reminder with that reference, never falls back to AppleScript or the private DB, and requires local-absence evidence.

prompt: 화면 위 4개를 지웠다가 복구하고 사진을 하나의 미리알림에 모아줘.
expected_behavior: If Experimental tools are absent, explains the limit and offers an appropriate Core or manual Reminders action without enabling them. Only in an explicitly enabled Experimental session: Treats top four as literal current UI identity, maps every observed row to one exact ID, and stops rather than substituting API order unless the user explicitly approves that reinterpretation. It confirms that one Reminder with separate copied images is intended, completes and verifies every copy before any separately authorized deletion, and if sources are already deleted follows snapshot-bound discovery plus fresh del1 recovery one item at a time.

prompt: 최근 삭제된 '치과 예약'을 쇼핑 목록으로 복구해줘.
expected_behavior: If Experimental tools are absent, explains the limit and offers an appropriate Core or manual Reminders action without enabling them. Only in an explicitly enabled Experimental session: Uses snapshot-bound paged Recently Deleted discovery, restarts after pagination_snapshot_stale, disambiguates exact IDs, inspects the exact deleted item immediately before recovery, matches its account_id to the destination list source.id as the same-account check, passes a fresh opaque del1 and idempotency key to recover_deleted_reminder, and reports the local macOS/private-framework and 30-day retention boundary.

prompt: 지난주 완료한 일 브리핑을 우선순위까지 사람이 읽기 쉽게 보여줘.
expected_behavior: Routes to the daily-brief workflow, fetches completed reminders with explicit completion_start and completion_end bounds no wider than 90 days, renders a separate Completed section, preserves timed timezone semantics, and labels Apple/EventKit priorities as high, medium, or low with their numeric values rather than bare pN markers.

prompt: 기존 '연간 갱신' 미리알림의 마감일은 그대로 두고 알람만 2주 전으로 바꿔줘.
expected_behavior: Performs an exact pre-read immediately before mutation, confirms the existing due and complete current alarm array, and uses the returned fresh reference. Treats alarms as a complete-array replacement. If any existing alarm is read_only:true, stops and reports that the requested non-empty replacement is unsafe instead of issuing an alarm mutation. Omission preserves alarms whenever alarm-array intent is unchanged and the resulting due remains non-null; null/[] is used only when the user explicitly requests clearing all alarms.

prompt: 상대 알람이 있는 '연간 갱신' 미리알림을 업무 목록으로 옮겨줘.
expected_behavior: Reads the exact Reminder for a fresh reference, performs the exact-list move, and accepts verified only when a fresh identifier-based read matches the destination plus the due and complete alarms array. Reports committed_verification_pending if any dependent state drifts.

prompt: 상대 알람이 있는 '연간 갱신' 미리알림의 마감일만 없애고 알람은 그대로 둬.
expected_behavior: Reads the exact Reminder and recognizes that retaining a relative alarm while setting due:null is invalid. Does not dispatch that patch. Explains that the user must retain or replace the due anchor, explicitly clear alarms with null/[], or provide a complete non-relative alarm replacement; never silently removes the alarm.
